downloads.dialogHelp: Search a public Hugging Face repository, choose a complete GGUF variant, then prepare a download plan. Private or gated repositories are not supported.

downloads.createProfileHelp: Choose a detected model and engine. Configuration opens for the selected model; saving the profile and starting a server are separate. A matching saved profile may open.
downloads.createProfileDemoNotice: Browser demo: model files are not downloaded, so there is no installed model to configure.
downloads.createProfileNoModel: The downloaded model is not in the model library yet. Check its folder and rescan the library.
downloads.createProfileNoEngine: No installed engine is compatible with this model.
downloads.createProfileStrataNeedsConfig: Strata needs a prepared model configuration before this model can be used.
downloads.removeHelp: This removes only the temporary files owned by this download. Installed models and other downloads are kept.
downloads.diskSpaceWarning: There may not be enough free space for this download.
downloads.hubQuery: Find models by name or publisher
downloads.hubHelp: Models from different Hugging Face publishers. Search the full catalog; file size depends on quantization. Architecture support depends on your llama.cpp version.
downloads.hubEmpty: No repositories found. Try another name or use a direct GGUF URL.
downloads.strataCatalogHelp: The catalog comes from your installed Strata, just like its own interface. Installation downloads and prepares the complete model, tokenizer, packs, MTP and vision files where supported.
downloads.catalogFallback: Could not read the installed Strata catalog. Showing the reference catalog; update or configure Strata before installing.
downloads.memoryAdvisory: This model may exceed available memory. You can download it now and run it later on suitable hardware.
downloads.strataMemory: Weight memory ≈ {{memory}} GiB RAM + VRAM · download ≈ {{size}} GiB
downloads.hubSizeHelp: Size of a GGUF variant reported by Hugging Face. The exact complete download size is shown after choosing a quantization.
downloads.bundleContents: Includes weights, tokenizer and the extra files required by this Strata model. Memory use also depends on context and launch settings.
downloads.purposeVision: Text and image understanding. Select a compatible image projector with the GGUF variant.
downloads.purposeEmbedding: Text embeddings for search and retrieval.
downloads.purposeText: Text generation, chat and working with documents. Available quantizations are shown before download.
downloads.allGguf: All GGUF, including models without a llama.cpp app tag
downloads.quantAbout.Q2_0: The smallest Flash Next variant, prioritizing speed and low memory use.
downloads.quantAbout.IQ2_XS: Compact quantization with a balance of speed and quality.
downloads.quantAbout.IQ3_XXS: Higher precision than IQ2_XS, with more memory use and CPU work.
downloads.quantAbout.IQ3_S: Higher precision with greater memory requirements.
downloads.quantAbout.IQ1_M: Coding variant with mixed expert precision to reduce memory use.
downloads.quantAbout.coding: A model variant for programming and working with code.
downloads.quantAbout.general: Native Strata variant with automatic preparation of required files.
downloads.quantAbout.llama: Ready-to-download GGUF for chat and everyday text tasks.
